statement: The Epoch Capabilities Index gain in 2027 is < 50% of its 2025 gain (Epoch AI; resolves 2028-01)
status_at_phase_end: 2025 is the baseline year, and the index itself only launched in October 2025. As of the Dec-2025 vintage, the frontier stood at ~154 (a Bloc A developer's model released 2025-11-18); GPT-5 = 150 by construction (anchor). Epoch reported a frontier rate of ~15 pts/yr since an April-2024 breakpoint (vs ~8 before). No official '2025 gain' number was published in-phase; the end-2024 frontier value on the Dec-2025 vintage was not retrieved, so the baseline must be computed from the scale in force at resolution (later vintages put it at ~12.4). In-phase evidence pointed to continued fast progress, not a plateau.

items.summary: Before the composite index existed, the benchmark tracker reported steady capability gains over the prior 12 months across math, agentic coding, visual and common-sense reasoning (e.g. +25 pts on a graduate science benchmark, +52 pts on a coding benchmark, +23 pts on research-level math).
items.detail: Epoch AI Data Insight 'AI capabilities have steadily improved over the past year' (2025-09-30): GPQA Diamond +25%, Aider Polyglot +52%, VPCT +26%, SimpleBench +21%, FrontierMath +23% (Oct 2024 - Jul 2025). Verified via web_extract.

items.summary: The capabilities index named by this indicator was launched in October 2025: an item-response-style composite of ~40 benchmarks, scaled so that a mid-2024 model = 130 and a mid-2025 flagship = 150. The indicator's series begins here; earlier values are retrospective fits.
items.detail: Epoch AI Brief October 2025 (2025-10-31, verified) announcing the ECI; LessWrong 'Introducing the Epoch Capabilities Index' (Oct 2025). Anchors: Claude 3.5 Sonnet = 130, GPT-5 = 150 (ECI FAQ). Exact launch day not verified; month-end brief used as published date.

items.summary: At launch, 2025 releases climbed the scale steadily: a spring reasoning model ~146.8, a mid-year model ~148.8, the August flagship 150 (anchor) and an October variant ~150.3, all from Bloc A developers.
items.detail: Values from the Dec-2025 vintage table in Epoch 'AI capabilities progress has sped up': o3 (2025-04-16) 146.76, o3-pro (2025-06-10) 148.75, Grok 4 (2025-07-09) 147.42, GPT-5 (2025-08-07) 150.00, GPT-5 Pro (2025-10-07) 150.33. Launch-vintage values may differ by <1 pt.

items.summary: End-2025 frontier on the index: ~154.0 (Bloc A developer, released 2025-11-18), followed by ~152.9 and ~152.0 for two December releases; about +4 over the August anchor model within four months.
items.detail: Epoch Data Insight 'AI capabilities progress has sped up' (2025-12-23; CSV updated 2025-12-29), verified: Gemini 3 Pro 153.99, Gemini 3 Flash 152.88, GPT-5.2 (xhigh) 152.03, Claude Opus 4.5 149.93.

items.summary: Epoch: the best index score grew almost twice as fast in the last two years as in the two before, with a breakpoint around April 2024 (~8 -> ~15 points/yr), consistent with a time-horizon acceleration. A 2027 gain below half of 2025 would require reverting below the pre-breakpoint pace.
items.detail: Same Data Insight (Edelman, Lee). Later superseded (Sept 2026 insight, April 2026 report) - superseding content is post-phase and not used here.

items.summary: No official '2025 gain' figure was published in-phase, and the index is refitted as models are added (historical values shift ~0.5-1 pt). The baseline the indicator needs must be recomputed on the scale in force at resolution.
items.detail: Dec-2025 vintage end-2024 frontier (o1) value not retrieved this run. Post-phase vintages give 142.67 -> 155.07 (=12.4), not used as in-phase evidence.
